message.content:
Based on my search, here are the best places to get tickets for the next NBA game:

## Official NBA Ticket Sources

**1. NBA Official Website (NBATickets.com)**
- The primary and most reliable source is **https://nbatickets.nba.com** — the NBA's official ticket marketplace
- This is the only officially authorized ticket marketplace of the NBA, powered by Ticketmaster
- You can search for single game tickets, season ticket packages, group tickets, special offers, and more
- The site includes an official resale marketplace for tickets being sold by other ticket holders
- All tickets are verified authentic, and you receive/send tickets securely and electronically

**2. Ticketmaster**
- **https://www.ticketmaster.com** — The official ticketing provider of the NBA
- Most NBA teams use Ticketmaster as their primary ticket supplier
- Offers full-price original tickets, variable-priced tickets through authorized dealers, and fan resale tickets
- All tickets sold through Ticketmaster are verified as authentic

## Team-Specific Official Options

Many individual NBA teams sell tickets directly through their official websites, which typically link to Ticketmaster. You can visit your favorite team's official website and click on their schedule/tickets section.

## Reputable Secondary Marketplaces

If games are sold out or you're looking for specific seats, these trusted resale platforms are recommended:

| Platform | Website | Notes |
|----------|---------|-------|
| **StubHub** | https://www.stubhub.com/nba-tickets | Major resale marketplace with buyer protection |
| **SeatGeek** | https://seatgeek.com | Popular aggregator with price comparisons |
| **Vivid Seats** | https://www.vividseats.com | Well-established resale platform |
| **Viagogo** | https://www.viagogo.com | International ticket marketplace |
| **Gametime** | https://gametime.co | Last-minute ticket deals |
| **TicketCity** | https://www.ticketcity.com | Long-running ticket broker |

## International/Regional Options

- **WAUG** (https://www.waug.com) — Popular in Asia for NBA tickets with local currency payment options
- **KKday** (https://www.kkday.com) — Offers tickets for popular teams like Lakers, Heat, and Clippers
- **观赛日/Saiday** (http://www.saiday.com) — Chinese platform for global sports tickets

## Important Tips

1. **Buy early** — NBA tickets, especially for popular teams (Lakers, Knicks, Warriors, Celtics), sell out quickly
2. **Avoid scams** — Only use reputable platforms; avoid buying from forums, individuals directly, or websites with prices that seem too good to be true
3. **Use secure payment** — Pay with credit card or PayPal for buyer protection
4. **Check for promotions** — Many platforms offer discounts for new users or members
5. **Consider box office** — You can sometimes buy tickets in-person at the arena on game day, though availability is limited

For the safest experience with guaranteed authentic tickets, **https://nbatickets.nba.com** is your best starting point.
